name: Incidents
job: An incident's timeline gathered as it happens, and the write-up after
intro: Incidents opens a channel for each incident and keeps its timeline from the channel, GitHub and Triage. Your Lemma names a likely cause with its evidence, drafts the updates the lead sends, and drafts the write-up on resolve, every claim linked to what happened.
does: Declare from the app or by asking your Lemma in Slack: a channel, a pinned header kept current, and #incidents told.
A likely cause with its evidence, what it ruled out, and every source it couldn't check.
A write-up where every claim links to its event, with the claims nothing backs flagged, and follow-ups as team tasks.

accounts.why: One shared Slack connection, the same app as your Lemma's bot: it opens each incident's channel, pins the header and posts the updates the lead sends.
One shared GitHub connection: merges, pushes, deploy workflow runs and releases in the repositories you pick, for what changed before an incident.
Only to email updates to a list of people, when your Lemma has its own mailbox.

setup: Once for the whole Lemma: the Slack account and #incidents, the repositories to watch, who gets updates by email, and your severity words.
Or look around with a sample incident: a payments outage, its timeline and three past write-ups.
Declare from the app, or say "@Lemma declare checkout 502s" in Slack.
